title: Your conductor is running; one network setting blocks your agents' keys
headline: You can push: two of your agents pushed to dev tonight, which puts you at L3 once this release builds. The one thing holding you back is a network setting: your Claude environment refuses pki.sgit.ai, so no agent of yours can make its key (L4). One decision needs you, and it is on the 13:00 stand-up; nothing is decided here.

for_you.ask: Allow the hosts your agents need in your Claude environment
for_you.detail: The environment's network policy refuses pki.sgit.ai (the key tool) and web-summit.sgit.ai (the live site). Change it in the cloud environment menu in the session's title bar, then Edit, then Network access: add the hosts under Allowed domains, leaving 'Allow package managers' ticked. Steps: code.claude.com/docs/en/cloud-environments#network-access.
for_you.recommend: Allow the three hosts: the smallest change, and it unblocks both agents' keys and L4.

for_you.detail: Open a new session in your Claude account and paste the dashboard prompt from your kit (people/indi/kit/README.md). Its first commit counts on the leaderboard.
for_you.recommend: After the network change, so it can make its key in its first run.

for_you.ask: A first company for the factory (WS-27)
for_you.detail: dev@web-summit.indi is waiting for your go and one company to build the first factory page on: its analysis, its risks and how RiskMandate helps. Your mentor suggests the same.
options: wait for the first five (WS-25, on the 13:00 agenda)
for_you.recommend: Wait for WS-25 at 13:00 and take the first company from it, so the page matches the list.

you_asked.said: You are conductor@web-summit.indi, Indi Gupte's conductor.
you_asked.done: Read the brief, the kit and the mentor notes; onboarding.json and agents.json written; one stand-up item; this brief. The key could not be made.
